digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, completion verifier, attestation defense
propositions: A code-verifiable acceptance criterion tagged [operator-attested] when evidence exists as exact repo path/symbol facts bypasses plan-review guards and reaches the completion verifier, which accepts it by tag alone per ADR-0043, enabling attestation laundering.

The evidence-kind criterion on plan-review runs fails to reject mistagged repo-provable ACs due to LLM judgment miss with no deterministic backstop; det_measurement_provenance detects missing provenance lines but is wired as advisory (p6_ac_quality), insufficient to block.

A new deterministic pre-LLM close-path guard det_attestation_launder.py with laundering_gaps() detector rejects [operator-attested] ACs citing exact repo paths/symbols/pytest node IDs before completion verifier runs, with untag/split remediation.

Missing or incomplete provenance: continuation lines on tagged ACs are now blocked at close (det_measurement_provenance.provenance_gaps promoted to blocking on close path only; review-side P6 remains advisory).

Mixed-evidence ACs (repo-verifiable half + external outcome) are rejected with coaching to split into separate untagged and tagged criteria; test-shaped citations always fire as completion proof; other repo citations fire only when preceded by evidence-introducing words.

Commits 1dfe003a50 (change 1791) merged to origin/main, tested with 29+ new unit and e2e tests (all mutants killed), lint/typecheck clean, and operator attestation via authenticated Gerrit REST voting (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).
